channel.title: Persistent Volume Claim on KubeSphere
channel.description: Recent content in Persistent Volume Claim on KubeSphere

item.title: Create a NAS-Type PersistentVolumeClaim
item.description: This section describes how to create a NAS-type PersistentVolumeClaim. After the PersistentVolumeClaim is created, the backend storage system will automatically create a corresponding PersistentVolume and bind it. For other methods of creating a PersistentVolumeClaim, please refer to Create a PersistentVolumeClaim. Prerequisites You need to join a cluster or project and have the PersistentVolumeClaim Management permission in the cluster or project. For more information, please refer to Cluster Roles and Project Roles.

item.title: Create a Persistent Volume Claim from a Volume Snapshot
item.description: This section describes how to create a persistent volume claim from a volume snapshot. In addition to creating a persistent volume claim on the Volume Snapshots page, you can also choose to create it from a volume snapshot when creating a persistent volume claim. For other methods of creating a persistent volume claim, refer to Create a Persistent Volume Claim. Prerequisites You need to join a cluster or project and have the Persistent Volume Claim Management permission in the cluster or project.
